title: The Patents Act, 1970
authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
effective_date: Commencement appointed by separate Central Government notification (Chapter I, Sec.1(3)) — confirm exact date separately if needed
summary: Primary Indian statute governing patentability, incl. Section 3(p) traditional-knowledge exclusion and Section 3(e) mere-admixture exclusion.

title: The Patents (2nd Amendment) Rules, 2020
source: Gazette of India, Part II Section 3(i), No. 565
authority: CGPDTM / Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
summary: Amends the Patents Rules, 2003 under Section 159 of the Patents Act, 1970. Comes into force on the date of Gazette publication.

title: The Patents (Amendment) Rules, 2024
source: Gazette of India, Part II Section 3(i), No. 197
summary: Further amends the Patents Rules, 2003 under Section 159 of the Patents Act, 1970. This is the most recent Patent Rules amendment in this corpus — check IP India directly for anything newer.

title: The Trade Marks Act, 1999
source: Gazette of India, Part II Section 1, No. 60 (Ministry of Law, Justice and Company Affairs)
summary: Act No. 47 of 1999; consolidates trademark law, replacing the Trade & Merchandise Marks Act, 1958. Effective date (15 Sept 2003) per the 'New Elements' note in this same reference set — cross-check against a primary notification if precision matters.

title: The Trade Marks (Amendment) Act, 2010
effective_date: Commencement appointed by separate Central Government notification
summary: Amends Sections 11 and 21 (among others) of the Trade Marks Act, 1999.

title: The Trade Marks Rules, 2017
source: Gazette of India, Part II Section 3(i), No. 159
summary: Made under Section 157 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999, superseding the Trade Marks Rules, 2002.

title: New Elements in Trade Marks Act, 1999 (IP India informational note)
source: IP India informational summary (not a gazette-published instrument)
effective_date: N/A — explanatory note, not a legal instrument
summary: Short explanatory note listing major changes introduced by the Trade Marks Act, 1999 vs. the earlier Trade & Merchandise Marks Act, 1958 (incl. the 15 Sept 2003 in-force date). Treat as secondary/explanatory, not as authoritative statutory text.

title: The Designs Act, 2000
source: Gazette of India, Extraordinary Part II-Section I (published 12 May 2000)
effective_date: Commencement appointed by separate Central Government notification
summary: Act No. 16 of 2000; consolidates and amends the law relating to protection of designs.

title: The Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999
source: Gazette of India, Extraordinary Part II-Section 1, No. 61
effective_date: Commencement appointed by separate Central Government notification
summary: Act No. 48 of 1999; provides for registration and protection of geographical indications — relevant to region/community-linked medicinal plant or product names.

title: The Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2023
source: Gazette of India, Part II Section 1, No. 21
authority: Ministry of Law and Justice (cross-cutting decriminalization act)
effective_date: Different dates per enactment amended (Section 1(2)) — check the Schedule entry for the specific Act you care about
summary: Act No. 18 of 2023. NOT GI-Act-specific despite the filename — its Schedule amends multiple IP statutes: Copyright Act 1957 (Section 68 omitted), Patents Act 1970 (Section 120 penalty amended), Trade Marks Act 1999 (Sections 106/107 amended), and the GI Act 1999 (new sections inserted after Section 37). Cite the specific Schedule entry relevant to your query, not the Act as a whole.

title: The Copyright Act, 1957
effective_date: Commencement appointed by separate Central Government notification
summary: Act No. 14 of 1957; amends and consolidates the law relating to copyright.

title: Compendium of Varieties Registered under the PPV&FR Act, 2001 (Volume 1, 2009–2012)
source: Protection of Plant Varieties & Farmers' Rights Authority (PPV&FRA)
summary: IMPORTANT: this is a registry/compendium of already-registered plant varieties (2009–2012), NOT the text of the PPV&FR Act, 2001 itself, despite the filename. Useful for checking whether a specific variety is already registered; not a source for Section-level statutory citations. You still need the actual Act text separately.

title: Compendium of Registered Varieties under the PPV&FR Act, 2001 (Volume 2, 2013–2017)
source: Protection of Plant Varieties & Farmers' Rights Authority (PPV&FRA)
summary: Same caveat as Volume 1 — a registry of registered varieties (2013–2017), not the Act text.

title: The Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Act, 2001 — Informational Brochure
authority: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Authority (PPV&FRA), Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
effective_date: N/A — plain-language brochure, not the statute itself
summary: IMPORTANT: this is PPV&FRA's own plain-language explainer (objectives, breeders'/researchers'/farmers' rights, registration fees, DUS testing, benefit-sharing overview) — it names specific provisions (e.g. Section 26 benefit-sharing, Section 39(2) compensation) but is NOT the full Act text with all sections, and it predates the 2021 Tribunals Reforms Act amendment (still describes the now-abolished PVPAT). For Section-level citations and appeal-route questions, use DOC-PPVFR-ACT-2001 (the actual bare-act text) instead — this brochure is background/context only.

title: The Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Act, 2001 (Act No. 53 of 2001, as amended up to Act No. 33 of 2021)
authority: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Authority (PPV&FRA)
effective_date: 2005-11-11 (Sections 2-13, 95-97, per Notification No. S.O. 1588(E)); 2006-10-19 (Section 1, Sections 14-94, per Notification No. S.O. 1797(E)). Consolidated to reflect amendments up to the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2021 (Act No. 33 of 2021), effective 2021-04-04.
summary: This is the actual bare-act text (11 Chapters, 97 sections) — supersedes the brochure/compendium files previously in this corpus (DOC-PPVFR-BROCHURE-2018, DOC-PPVFR-REGISTRY-VOL1/VOL2) as the authoritative source for Section-level citations. IMPORTANT: Sections 54, 55, 58 and 59 were omitted by the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2021 (which abolished the Plant Varieties Protection Appellate Tribunal / IPAB) — appeals now go directly to the High Court under amended Sections 56-57, not to a Tribunal. Any answer citing the old PVPAT/IPAB appeal route is citing obsolete law; ground appeal-route answers in Sections 56-57 as they stand in this file.

title: The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023
source: Gazette of India, Part II Section 1, No. 13
authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) / Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
effective_date: Commencement appointed by separate Central Government notification
summary: Act No. 10 of 2023; further amends the Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (18 of 2003). This file contains the amendment only — pair it with the original 2002 Act text if you need the full consolidated statute.

title: The Biological Diversity Rules, 2024
source: Gazette of India, Part II Section 3(i), No. 607 (G.S.R. 665(E))
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change / NBA
effective_date: Comes into force 60 days after Gazette notification (per Rule 1(2)) — notification dated 22 Oct 2024, so ~21 Dec 2024
summary: Made under Section 62 of the Biological Diversity Act, 2002; supersedes the Biological Diversity Rules, 2004.

title: The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules, 2025
source: Gazette of India, Part II Section 3(i), No. 252 (G.S.R. 295(E))
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change / NBA
summary: Further amends the Biological Diversity Rules, 2024, under Section 62 of the Biological Diversity Act, 2002.

title: The Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / CDSCO
effective_date: Chapter III/IV commencement per separate notification (Section 1(3))
summary: Act No. 23 of 1940; governs import, manufacture, distribution and sale of drugs and cosmetics.
